temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but dangerously overworked and needs rest; he may think a short retreat could help Gary gain perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's refusal confirms that his work commitments are consuming him and makes Ethan see that a simple invitation may not be enough.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is highly overcommitted and currently unable or unwilling to step away from hospital duties, putting his health at risk.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, caring, possibly disappointed or frustrated.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find a way to reduce work stress and rest, without giving up on intervening.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of discussions about work. Ethan confronts him about his suspicions, and Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked due to hospital or professional obligations, though he is concerned and senses Gary is stressed; Gary was initially reluctant about stepping away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest that the overwork is not only professional. Ethan now suspects deeper personal or emotional problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is more to Gary's overworking than just hospital duties; Gary is hiding or struggling with a complicated issue.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Gary to open up and to offer nonjudgmental support so he can understand what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan offers to help, suggesting prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities; Gary agrees.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork is tied to complicated issues beyond routine professional obligations, but he does not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary reveals the specific causes: pressure from managing a new department plus personal challenges. Gary also seems open to receiving help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's excessive work is caused by concrete management pressures and personal challenges; he needs and will accept support to find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief mixed with empathy and caring.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Gary reports that he is less overwhelmed, that Ethan's help has made a difference, and that he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is trying to improve with support, but may still face challenges and benefit from ongoing encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's reports and visible efforts show meaningful progress, confirming that Ethan's support is helping and that Gary can improve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making real progress toward a healthier work-life balance and is less overwhelmed, though challenges may remain.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary as he sustains his progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels much more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving but may still benefit from regular support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's sustained success and independence show that he no longer needs active intervention from Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthy work-life balance and can manage independently; Ethan's active support role can recede while he remains available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active intervention but let Gary know he is always available if needed.
